description: This file provides helper functions for interacting with a Supabase backend, specifically for counting and listing recent educational data such as courses, quizzes, assignments, and quiz attempts. It includes role-based functions for administrators, instructors, and students.

methods.name: countFrom(table, filters = (q) => q)
methods.description: Utility function to count records in a specified table with optional filters.

methods.name: getAdminCounts()
methods.description: Fetches total counts of courses, enrollments, assignments, quizzes, and quiz attempts system-wide for admin dashboards.

methods.name: getInstructorCounts(instructorId)
methods.description: Fetches counts of courses, enrollments, assignments, quizzes, and quiz attempts specific to an instructor.

methods.name: getStudentCounts(studentId)
methods.description: Fetches counts related to a student, including enrolled courses, assignments, quizzes, and attempts.

methods.name: listRecentItems({ role, userId, limit = 5 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves recent educational items tailored to the role: admin, instructor, or student.

ctags.name: listRecentItems
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listRecentItems({ role, userId, limit = 5 } = {}) {$/
